business_summary.text: Expanded distribution channel for ice cream products into Faridabad, Haryana.

industry: Fast Moving Consumer Goods > Food Products > Dairy Products

operating_notes.text: Inaugurated Sheetal Food Safari plant at Amreli, Gujarat for manufacturing Ready-to-Eat and Ready-to-Cook food products on June 1, 2026.
Commenced distribution channel for Sheetal Ice Cream products in Faridabad, Haryana on October 23, 2026.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹133.31 Cr, net profit ₹8.17 Cr.
Sheetal Cool Products commenced operations at its new Sheetal Food Safari manufacturing plant in Amreli, Gujarat on June 1, 2026.
Sheetal Cool Products commenced its distribution channel for ice cream in Faridabad, Haryana on October 23, 2026.
